topics.title: NR2B NAM – MDD Ph3 China Integration Strategy

background.text: Global asset team proposes US acceleration plan (Go scenario from MDD Ph2 readouts): two US-focused trials for accelerated US launch (+4 months) and two global (RoW) trials for CN/JP NDA with postponed NDA/launch vs. current plan (3 parallel MRCTs).
background.quote: The global asset team is proposing an US acceleration plan assuming a Go scenario from MDD Ph2 readouts. Two US focused trials will be conducted to support accelerated US launch by 4 months; and two global (RoW) trials will be conducted to support CN/JP NDA with postponed NDA and launch compared with the current plan (3 parallel MRCTs).

background.text: China team proposes to enroll ~40 Chinese patients (10 sites) per US-focused trial to ensure simultaneously accelerated NDA submission with registrational and operational feasibility without impacting global US launch timeline.
background.quote: The China team proposes to participate in the US focus trials by enrolling approximately 40 Chinese patients (10 sites) per trial. This approach aims to ensure simultaneously accelerated NDA submission, with registrational and operational feasibility for China without impacting the global timeline for the US launch.

background.text: China base case approval: Nov 2029. Prof. Gang Wang (Beijing An'Ding Hospital) accepted invitation as China Leading PI for NR2B NAM Ph3 in MDD (visited Mar 24th). 1st wave internal MSL/commercial training completed May 12th.
background.quote:
Prof Gang Wang from Beijing An’Ding Hospital was visited on Mar 24th to update on CONNEX results and he accepted the invitation as the China Leading PI for NR2B NAM Ph3 in MDD.
1st wave internal training for MSLs and commercial team was completed on May 12th.

decision.text: China Integration Strategy into NR2B NAM MDD Ph3 endorsed by Mar CEC (TA-CEC).

todo.text: Update China integration strategy after MDD Ph2 adjunctive readout; evidence gap analysis to be performed within limited scope of local members; strategy to be aligned with global team after Ph2 readouts. Owner/due date: 原文未说明。

topics.title: GA Evidence Gap Analysis – Anti-C3 GA ECR (Geographic Atrophy)

background.text: Timeline delayed 4–5 months due to GA ECR contract process. Local evidence team proposes: (1) accelerate enrollment and perform early IA with 6-month follow-up from <50 patients (pre-defined IA sample size) to catch up with Ph3 decision point in July 2026 for Anti-C3; (2) evaluate feasibility/risk of informal HAI with CDE after positive PMDA informal/non-binding consultation allowing JP integration into Anti-C3 Ph3 without early data; (3) search for additional GA evidence beyond ECR database.
background.quote:
With timeline delayed by 4-5 months due to GA ECR contract process, local evidence team proposes:
Accelerate enrollment and perform early IA with 6 months follow-up from less than 50 patients (the pre-defined sample size for IA) to catch up with the ph3 decision point in July 2026 for Anti-C3.
The team is evaluating the feasibility and risk to conduct informal HAI with CDE after positive feedback from PMDA informal/non-binding consultation which allows JP integration into Anti-C3 Ph3 without early data.
Search for additional evidence or insights on GA beyond the GA ECR database.
